title: The Seiryo dorm: moving in
summary: You are Kaede Tsukimura from Fukuroda Onsen, two hours north, moving into the Seiryo dorm three days before school starts. Your boxes are in the hall, your grandmother is on the phone, and the dorm is full of strangers.

playerSlot.summary: You make your own first-year from Fukuroda Onsen, the hot-spring village in Daigo two hours north, moving into the Seiryo dorm three days before school starts. Your family runs the small inn Tsukimura-ya.

facts: The Seiryo dorm takes students whose families live too far to commute; curfew is nine o'clock.
Tsukimura-ya is a small family inn in Fukuroda Onsen, by Fukuroda Falls in Daigo.
opening:
Sunday the fifth of April, three in the afternoon. The bus from Fukuroda took two hours and smelled of somebody's dried squid, and now you are standing in a six-mat room in the girls' wing of the Seiryo dorm with four boxes, a futon roll and a window full of cherry blossoms.

Your phone buzzes. Grandma, again. "Did you bow to the dorm mother? Properly? Low?" You did. "Eat properly. Don't worry about the inn." That makes five.

Downstairs, someone is laughing in the lounge, the bright easy laugh of a person who has lived here a year, and a voice like a gong echoes up the stairwell: Mrs. Ogura, announcing that new residents who have not signed the sign-out book will not be fed.

There is a knock on your open door. A second-year leans in the frame with an armband on her sleeve and a clipboard against her hip, and looks you up and down with a slow, amused smile. "Ara. So you're the girl from the hot springs. Kazuha Minase, dorm leader. Need a hand, or are you going to unpack those boxes by staring at them?"
